caption: The drawing consists of two main sections on a beige background. In the upper portion, there is a lightly sketched outline of a vase, drawn in thin pencil lines. Inside this outline, there is a simple linear depiction of a bird perched above two leaves. In the lower portion of the page, occupying the center, there is a rectangular gray area filled with watercolor or wash. Within this darker gray rectangle, there is a more detailed drawing of a bird in black ink or pencil, standing above two large leaves, similar to the motif in the vase outline above. The bird faces to the right, and both the bird and the leaves are outlined in black with minimal internal detail. At the bottom right beneath the gray rectangle, there appears to be a faint handwritten signature.
title: Jar
